# State Class View (variant): Environmental compliance inspector (local)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> All task importance, time share, critical, needed-at-entry and target-level values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Credential gates and sign-off are shown only as drafts until an E-labelled source is attached.

- **Role:** Environmental compliance inspector (`seed:R12-environmental-compliance-inspector`, P1); authority position (editorial): regulator
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
- Target inspections and verify compliance using monitoring data and analytics — journey L2, senior L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — journey L2, senior L3
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
